name: DANAE
full_name: Direct dArk matter detection using DEPFET with repetitive Non-destructive readout Application Experiment
summary: DANAE develops DEPFET silicon pixels with repeated nondestructive readout, using few-electron events to explore low-mass dark matter.
detection_principle: Charge is collected in depleted silicon. Repeated measurements reduce readout noise, allowing sub-electron precision for identifying dark-matter–electron scattering.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
